title: Epoxy Floor Coating quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription:
Epoxy floor coating for a double garage, approximately 6.5m x 6m (39 sqm), located in Brighton East, Melbourne, for a client named Riley.
Surface preparation: Diamond grinding of the entire approximately 39 square metres of concrete floor.
Crack repair: One linear metre of minor crack repair near the rear wall using epoxy filler.
Primer: Application of one coat of high-solids epoxy primer across the entire 39 square metres.
Base Coat: Application of two coats of medium grey (e.g., Dulux 'Grey Pail') epoxy base coat across the 39 square metres, allowing for appropriate cure time between coats.
Decorative Flake Broadcast: Full broadcast of black vinyl flakes (e.g., 'Midnight') into the wet second base coat.
Topcoat: Application of one clear, UV-stable polyurethane topcoat with a fine anti-slip aggregate (e.g., 50-micron silica) across the 39 square metres.
workingDetail: Diamond grinding / surface preparation, Epoxy primer, Epoxy base coat (colour), Anti-slip aggregate (optional)
